_comment: Receipt carrying the ors.mandate extension at action_context.ors.mandate, binding the recorded purchase action to an OpenTerms Mandate commitment. The extension content is the worked example from the OpenTerms Mandate Workstream 1 commitment specification, Section 6.2, used verbatim: mandate_id, mandate_hash, scope_snapshot, and chain_depth=0. The mandate is a separately-signed artifact under its own domain-separation prefix (OTMANDATE-v0.1\x00); the ORS receipt signature does not sign the mandate. See ORS-v0.3.md Section 11.1 for the extension definition and signing boundary.
_note: The signature is illustrative. Use verify.py with a live issuer JWKS to verify real receipts. The canonical_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical payload per Section 4 and is reproducible from the payload fields shown here.
